title: The Gambia National Climate Change Act, 2026
citation: The Gambia National Climate Change Bill, 2026 (earlier titled the Gambia National Climate Change Bill, 2025): third reading 1 April 2026, National Assembly Record of Votes and Proceedings of that sitting
evidence: Votes and Proceedings of Wednesday 1 April 2026 (https://assembly.gm/documents/296, opened 2026-11-05): "the Hon. Minister for Environment, Climate Change and Natural Resources moved a motion for the National Climate Change Bill, 2026 to be read a Third Time and Passed ... The Assembly agreed that the Bill be read a Third Time and Passed." No official page found states the date of presidential assent, the Act number or commencement.
notes: Link only: the text of the Act is not published on assembly.gm (a title search of Bills and Acts finds no climate bill or Act; only the Votes and Proceedings record it) and meccnar.gov.gm (Acts & Regulations page) does not hold it. The MECCNAR news item of 24 June 2026 (https://meccnar.gov.gm/meccnar-validates-climate-change-act-general-implementing-regulations-2026) calls it the Climate Change Act and says the General Implementing Regulations were still a draft at validation; a press report of 18 May 2026 says the Act awaited presidential assent, which no official page confirms either way. Per the Votes and Proceedings of 16 March 2026 (https://assembly.gm/documents/298) the clause-by-clause stage covered the National Climate Change Council, the Department and the Climate Change Fund. The regulations are not enacted and have no entry.
status_note: Passed by the National Assembly on 2026-04-01; assent, Act number, commencement and published text not confirmed on any official page as of 2026-11-05.

title: National Environment Management Act, 1994 (Act No. 13 of 1994)
citation: National Environment Management Act 1994 (Act No. 13 of 1994), assented to 24 May 1994
evidence: Scanned Act (opened 2026-11-05): the first page of the Act reads "No. 13 of 1994. Assented to by The President, this Twenty-Fourth day of May, 1994"; the date line "27th May, 1994" is printed above Part I beside the enacting words (read on the page image), read here as the date of commencement because the Act has no commencement clause and no other date is printed; the reading is an inference, not a stated commencement.
notes: Establishes the National Environment Management Council and the National Environment Agency; Part V covers environmental impact assessment (offences relating to impact assessments, s. 53) and the polluter-pays principle is in the preamble. The only copy found is the 83-page scan on meccnar.gov.gm, so the record is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (extraction ocr); the typewritten original gives some misread words (for example "Trenty-Fourth"). No amending Act was found on assembly.gm or meccnar.gov.gm; the National Environment Management Bill 2025 and 2026 (https://assembly.gm/documents/363 and https://assembly.gm/documents/480) are Bills, not law. English is the only language of Gambian legislation, so there is no other language or translation to store.

title: Gambia Consumer Protection Act, 2014
citation: Gambia Consumer Protection Act 2014, Supplement B to The Gambia Gazette No. 2 of 3 February 2014
evidence: The PDF on assembly.gm (https://assembly.gm/documents/138/download, opened 2026-11-05) is headed "A BILL ENTITLED" with the enacting words and a blank date bracket; s. 1: "shall come into force on such dare [date] as the Minister may appoint by notice published in the Gazette". No official page found states assent or the commencement notice.
notes: Link only: the only text found is the Gazette print of the Bill, which has no assent or commencement date, so a record cannot be dated. The brief gave assent as 12 May 2014; no official page read says so. s. 12(5)(e) lists "Advertising infringing environmental values" as abusive advertising; ss. 12(2) to 12(3) make false or misleading advertising subject to investigation and prosecution. Administered with the Gambia Competition and Consumer Protection Commission and a Consumer Tribunal.
status_note: Only the Bill print was found; commencement is by ministerial notice in the Gazette, not located.
